title: Generated in-memory DBCOLOR late-callback entity appearance binding
scope: Reconcile DWG entity AcDbColor references with later OBJECTS DBCOLOR callbacks inside the concrete adapter, preserving per-import handle identity, inline entity overrides, bounded retention, and fail-closed unresolved/conflicting references.

behavior: Retained DWG entities with AcDbColor handles are indexed by import generation and referenced object handle.
The later DBCOLOR callback retains its bounded RGB and BOOK$ENTRY appearance and applies it to matching retained entities only when inline RGB/name values are absent.
Reused source handles in separate imports remain isolated by generation.
Missing targets, invalid identities/values, duplicate definitions, and allocation/retention failures fail adapter capture; output preflight rejects incomplete DBCOLOR appearance bindings.
Appearance patches are staged before entity mutation so a staging failure leaves all matching entities unchanged.
implementation.sourceOrder: The generated callback test invokes entity callbacks before the OBJECTS DBCOLOR callback, matching the DWG read-section order used by dx_iface.

control.profile: Locally authored in-memory AC1027 callback profile with two entities sharing one referenced DBCOLOR, explicit inline color/name precedence, a second import reusing handles, and a duplicate definition control.
assertions: Missing target remains incomplete until its generation-matched DBCOLOR callback arrives.
RGB and BOOK$ENTRY name are applied after the late callback.
Existing inline RGB/name values are preserved.
A second import's reused handle binds only to its own DBCOLOR value.
A duplicate same-generation definition is refused without replacing the first value.
control.fixtureDisposition: No DWG/DXF fixture was created or added; the selector constructs callback values in memory.

validation.asanSelectorResult: passed with no AddressSanitizer finding; detect_leaks was omitted because this platform runtime reports it unsupported

limitations: This is generated in-memory adapter callback evidence, not a physical DWG producer observation.
The DBCOLOR source frame and ACAD_COLOR dictionary ownership/entry graph are not emitted by this change; strict source-to-output conversion must continue to refuse the unsupported object path.
Fresh DXF readback and native color-book display are not qualified.
nextReadyPacket: Continue P4 source/output graph closure for the DBCOLOR source frame and ACAD_COLOR dictionary route, or select the next independently reproduced strict-output source dependency; retain physical/native color-book qualification as separate gates.
